description.narrative: Programmet syftar till att bidra till att fördjupa och stärka ideologisk tydlighet på Transformativ feministisk agenda för att främja social, jämställdhet, kvinnor empowerment och rörelsebyggande. Detta bidrag kommer att fokusera på att fördjupa förståelsen av transformativ feminism ideologi och katalyserar Transformative Feminism Movement Building med ett specifikt fokus på utbildning, hälsa, vatten, Jordbruk, utvinningsindustrier, handel och industri.

The programme aims to contribute towards deepening and enhancing ideological clarity on Transformative Feminist agenda for advancing social, gender equality, women empowerment, and movement building. This contribution will focus on deepening the understanding of Transformative Feminism ideology and catalyze the Transformative Feminism Movement Building with a specific focus on Education, Health, Water, Agriculture, Extractive Industries, Trade & Industry sectors.

The overall goal is to contribute towards deepening and enhancing ideological clarity on Transformative Feminist agenda for advancing social, gender equality, women empowerment, and movement building. The Transformative Feminism approach is based on the notion that both women and men are struggling for liberation from patriarchy and other oppressive systems. TGNP will deepen the understanding of Transformative Feminism ideology and catalyze the Transformative Feminism Movement Building with a specific focus on Education, Health, Water, Agriculture, Extractive Industries, Trade & Industry, sectors, as well as Cross-cutting issues. The selected cross-cutting issues include the following: gender-based violence, gender-responsive budgeting, environmental justice, ICT and innovation, participation of women in decision making, and participation of youth, especially, young women and girls as key players. The strategy aims to achieve the following four outcomes: Outcome 1: Increased generation and use of Transformative Feminism knowledge among civil society actors and particularly women rights organizations for evidencebased advocacy, collective organizing for enhanced movement building and public policy influencing Outcome 2: Strengthened transformative feminism and gender analytical capacity of women leaders and other actors to participate, influence and promote gender equality and social justice at all levels. Outcome 3: Expanded and strengthened transformative feminist movement spaces and platforms for advancing, gender equality and womens rights Outcome 4: Enhanced institutional and organizational capacity for further promotion of growth, sustainability and health organization for increased efficiency.

title.narrative: Tanzania Gender Networking Program (TGNP) core support
Tanzania Gender Networking Program (TGNP) core support

description.narrative:
Based on the TGNP 2023 Annual Report, several results were achieved, both expected and unexpected.
Expected Results
Strengthened Capacity in Gender and Transformative Feminism:Over 2,546 individuals (1,648 female and 898 male) were reached and engaged in training sessions focused on gender-responsive budgeting, gender analytical capacity, and gender mainstreaming .Training led to specific actions, such as the development of district action plans and budget allocations that supported gender-responsive initiatives like creating spaces for breastfeeding and addressing menstrual needs in schools.
Increased Awareness and Advocacy:Members of the Parliamentary Committee on Environment were made aware of gender gaps in biodiversity conservation and committed to integrating gender considerations into policies. They also advocated for higher representation of women in leadership positions within the Environmental Committee.
Training sessions for students in higher learning institutions resulted in increased gender-sensitive reporting and the establishment of gender desks in institutions like PSJ and Open University.
Enhanced Capacity of Women's Rights Organizations (WROs):WROs were trained in monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) skills, which improved their ability to document and share feminist realities, leading to tangible community changes.
Unexpected Results
Community-Led Initiatives: In Kishapu, Hon. Abdul Ngoromole's proposal for breastfeeding spaces and menstrual needs arose from the training sessions and demonstrated an unexpected community-level impact.
In Kiloleli, the completion of 12 pit latrines and special rooms for students with disabilities and girls during menstruation showcased the practical application of the training .
Environmental Conservation Efforts: Participants from various regions committed to using gas stoves to reduce reliance on firewood, advocated for clear demarcations to prevent construction in wildlife territories, and initiated tree planting within households.
The Embassy assess TGNP's interventions to have led significant progress in gender equality and women's empowerment across various sectors. These efforts have not only met the expected outcomes but have also resulted in unexpected, positive changes at the community level, showcasing the far-reaching impact of their programs.
